Title: Lagoon Mosaic Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind freeform bowl packed edge to edge with tumbled stone chips — turquoise, deep teal, petrol blue and pearly cream — suspended in clear resin the colour of shallow tropical water. The rim is left wild and uneven, dipping and rising the way a rock pool does, and light coming through the sides lights the chips up from behind.

One of the more material-heavy pieces in the collection: every chip is laid in by hand before the clear pour goes over the top.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Emerald Crush Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind deep bowl with the look of crushed emerald glass — sharp folds and facets running from a torn, crystalline rim down to a smooth pooled base. The green shifts from near-black in the creases to a bright leaf-green where the light passes through, and the whole thing glows when it's set anywhere near a window.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Stained Glass Serving Board
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind wooden paddle board finished in a poured resin top with a cell pattern like stained glass — irregular panes of lime green, violet, scarlet and burnt orange, each one edged in gold and shot through with a starburst at its centre. The colour runs right up over the handle and around the hanging hole, and the natural wood edge is left showing all the way round.

Built up in layers: the colour is painted on first, then sealed under a poured resin coat, then finished with a second clear coat over the top.

The resin is food-safe, so the board is ready for cheese, charcuterie or bread — but it's a serving board, not a chopping board, so please don't cut on it. Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Slate Bloom — Set of 4
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind set of four coasters in storm-grey and smoke, each one opening into a lacy petal pattern of fine white veins radiating from a soft olive-gold centre. The edges are built up in crushed black-and-white stone, so every coaster has a rough, geode-like border against the smooth face.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Midnight Chrysanthemum Trinket Dish
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind trinket dish with a great chrysanthemum opening across the whole face of it. The bloom starts as a peach-pink heart, flares out through butter-yellow and acid-lime petals, and cools into mossy green before it reaches a deep navy rim. Every ruffle in the edge catches the light differently, so the blue looks almost black in the folds and glassy where it turns.

Poured on its own in a single large mould, rather than several at a time — so no two are alike, and there is only ever one of this one.

Lovely under a jarred candle, a set of keys or a few rings. Resin doesn't like heat, though — nothing straight off the stove.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
